Hi Thomas —

Great questions. Quick summary up front, full details below and I attached a short playbook + metering CSV sample.

Summary:
- SKU mapping: We publish a deterministic SKU mapping table that links Marketplace SKUs to Redwood plans/features and to a usage metering key. That mapping is versioned and included in the onboarding bundle (see attachment meter-mapping.csv).
- Catalog ingest: We support a manifest JSON/CSV (examples attached) placed in a signed bucket path; CloudX can poll or ingest via a one-time webhook. Preferred format: newline-delimited JSON manifest with fields: sku, plan_id, display_name, region, pricing_unit, meter_key.
- Tenant isolation & evidence: For purchases routed via marketplace connector we emit an audit log per activation (activation_id) with meter_key, timestamp, tenant_id hash, and billing-period tag. We can provide a monthly export or a continuous feed to CloudX via secure SFTP or signed GCS URL.

Details and attachments below. If the marketplace team wants, Karthik and I can run a 30-min walkthrough of the playbook tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Hannah

Maria / Thomas —

Following up with technical specifics you asked for. I pasted a condensed manifest example below and included the full sample in the playbook.

---manifest.ndjson sample (one line per SKU)---
{"sku":"rwd-hosted-small","plan_id":"hosted-small-v1","display_name":"Redwood Hosted - Small","region":"us-west-2","pricing_unit":"token","meter_key":"meter.hosted.small","billing_window":"monthly"}

Operational notes:
- Placement: We recommend a signed S3/GCS path with object lock disabled for manifests that are intended to be reprocessed. Example path: s3://redwood-marketplace/mercantileplus/manifests/2026-08-20/manifest.ndjson
- Ingestion: CloudX webhooks are supported; we also support signed URL polling every 15 minutes. Manifests must include a checksum header for idempotency.
- Metering: For marketplace purchases we emit meter records in line with CloudX's metering schema (meter_key, activation_id, usage_units, timestamp, tenant_id_hash). We persist raw records for 18 months and can provide a signed monthly export or streaming feed.

Open items for procurement:
1) Reconciliation cadence — monthly CSV export or daily streaming? Please state preference.
2) Do you require a dedicated Marketplace-only tenant mapping table (we can provide) or will you accept the standard tenant_id_hash approach?

Happy to demo the export flow and log samples on a quick call.

-Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Integrations
